calculation.description: Lagged 20-session momentum normalized by 40-session realized volatility and adjusted inversely by the short-to-long volatility ratio. All inputs are available at the decision close; forward returns are used only for validation. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted momentum in relatively calmer volatility regimes.

validation.regime_notes: Positive mean IC in 2020-2022 (+0.053795), 2023-2024 (+0.018907), 2025-2026 (+0.024329), and 2027-2028 (+0.012429). Performance is positive across all tested regimes but weaker recently; use conservative ensemble weight and revalidate periodically.

provenance.cross_sectional_method: Spearman rank IC; dates with at least 8 valid instruments
